title: Exact Values of the Six Trigonometric Functions at Standard Angles (Table II)
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Without using a calculator, evaluate \sin\theta, \cos\theta, \tan\theta, \cot\theta, \sec\theta, and \csc\theta at each of the angles \theta = -3\pi/2, -\pi/3, -\pi/6, \pi/4, and 5\pi/6. State 'UND' wherever a function is undefined.

steps.title: Evaluate Sine and Cosine at Each Angle
steps.explanation: Note that -3*pi/2 is coterminal with pi/2, -pi/3 and -pi/6 lie in Quadrant IV, pi/4 lies in Quadrant I, and 5*pi/6 lies in Quadrant II with reference angle pi/6.
steps.why: Unit circle coordinates follow from special 30-60-90 and 45-45-90 triangles together with quadrant sign rules.

steps.title: Compute Tangent and Cotangent Values
steps.explanation: Evaluate tan theta = sin theta / cos theta and cot theta = cos theta / sin theta. At theta = -3*pi/2, cos theta = 0 so tan(-3*pi/2) is undefined and cot(-3*pi/2) = 0.
steps.why: Division by zero occurs in tan theta when cos theta = 0, whereas 0/1 = 0 for cot(-3*pi/2).

steps.title: Compute Secant and Cosecant Values
steps.explanation: Invert the cosine values to obtain sec theta (undefined at -3*pi/2) and invert the sine values to obtain csc theta.
steps.why: By definition, sec theta = 1/cos theta and csc theta = 1/sin theta.
